entities.summary: Joseph Mukuku Akhasamba is a Kenyan retired professional boxer who held the African heavyweight title from 1998 to 1999. As an amateur, he represented his native country at two consecutive Summer Olympics, starting in 1988. He won the gold medal in the men's light heavyweight division at the 1990 Commonwealth Games in Auckland, New Zealand.
